namedBy: CA-16 work brief, 'Bounded typed queries (no raw SQL from consumers)'
notes: These are the brief's named methods. CORRECTION-02's Q-01..Q-12 surface is withdrawn: it renamed and re-specified an API the batch already names, and reinvented a cursor contract that already exists and is accepted.
No method accepts or returns a SQL string. Raw SQL is private to the store owner.
No method falls back to scanning journals. A missing or stale index fails with SESSION_INDEX_MISSING or SESSION_INDEX_STALE.

provenance.description: Every result carries the identity of the store that produced it, so a caller can prove which index answered and detect a later rebuild.

commonResultEnvelope.truncationRule: truncated is true whenever a record or byte cap stopped the result short. Truncation never silently implies completeness; the caller must request the next page or escalate.

methods.name: getTurnExcerpt
methods.returns: stored excerpt with originalBytes, excerptBytes, and incomplete
methods.note: Returns only the stored excerpt. A consumer needing exact text reads the journal directly; this method never widens to full text and never scans history.

methods.name: listPins
methods.order: pinned_at ASC, ref_type ASC, ref_value ASC

methods.name: getReferenceCapsule
methods.note: The lane of the requesting session and the lane of the source turn are compared before any source content is read. A mismatch fails with OPERATOR_SESSION_REFERENCE_DENIED. Pruned source content resolves to its tombstone with OPERATOR_SESSION_CONTENT_PRUNED. Capsules are never expanded transitively.

errors.meaning: No index is present. Queries block; journals are never scanned as a fallback.
Manifest, index_meta, semantic root, or journal continuity disagree. Queries block until a deterministic rebuild.
No such operator session in this lane.
No such turn in this lane.
No such proposal in this lane.
Source content is pruned; the tombstone resolves instead.
Cursor is malformed or does not belong to this store identity.
